info.title: API-DocTest-List Ecommerce Cart Coupons-v3-spec
info.description: The Ecommerce Cart Coupon Management API provides a streamlined way for businesses to retrieve and manage promotional coupons associated with customer shopping carts. This API allows users to access active coupons, check their validity, and apply them to current cart sessions. Typical consumers include e-commerce platforms and developers looking to enhance shopping experiences through discounts. By integrating this API, businesses can easily optimize their promotions and drive customer engagement.

get.summary: Retrieve a coupon applied to the cart.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch details of the coupon that is currently applied to the user's shopping cart. It provides information about the coupon's validity, discount amount, and any applicable conditions.

requestBody.description: A JSON object representing the details required to apply a coupon to a shopping cart. Ensure that the coupon code is valid and any other necessary data is included as per the defined schema.

ListEcommerceCartCouponsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body expected for the GET operation related to cart coupons.
